title: Power Stack Forward Sweep — Oil Relief, Firm Dollar, Selective Risk-On

regime.structural: Capital scarcity / restrictive policy / AI funding discrimination
regime.tactical: Disinflationary oil + long-yield relief / selective AI-led risk-on
regime.breadth: Incomplete: banks/private credit/small caps are not yet full confirmation
regime.keyContradiction: WTI and 10Y are falling while DXY/front-end rates stay firm and Nasdaq/AI rallies; this is relief in the inflation/term-premium channel, not broad monetary easing.

forwardMap.baseCase: Firm-to-sideways; avoid assuming a collapse from lower oil alone.
forwardMap.why: Fed remains restrictive and front-end yields are sticky.
forwardMap.confirmation: PMI growth/prices resilient, US02Y firm, DXY holds around/above 100.
forwardMap.invalidation: PMI growth/prices soften materially, US02Y/real yields fall and broad FX confirms USD weakness.

forwardMap.baseCase: 2Y sticky; 10Y capped near/below 5% while WTI stays sub-$90s.
forwardMap.why: Fed path anchors front end; lower energy risk premium helps long end.
forwardMap.confirmation: Curve remains flat while oil stays weak.
forwardMap.invalidation: Strong PMI/prices or renewed oil shock sends 10Y back through 5%.

forwardMap.baseCase: Tactical upside/relative leadership remains favored while 10Y is contained.
forwardMap.why: AI earnings/capex demand plus market structure can overpower hawkish policy temporarily.
forwardMap.confirmation: Semis/AI hold leadership without a renewed 10Y/DXY surge.
forwardMap.invalidation: 10Y >5% with DXY acceleration, semis fail breakout, or credit/bank stress broadens.

forwardMap.why: Financials and major banks sold off while Nasdaq made a record; private-credit redemption pressure remains elevated.
forwardMap.confirmation: XLF/KRE/IWM/RSP catch up and credit conditions stabilize.
forwardMap.invalidation: Further bank relative weakness, wider spreads or deteriorating lending/funding.

forwardMap.baseCase: Crude risk premium remains biased lower while bypass/diplomacy progress persists; product tightness may outlast crude tightness.
forwardMap.why: Saudi bypass restart directly changes route availability; diesel/jet/refining constraints are separate physical bottlenecks.
forwardMap.confirmation: WTI stays below $90-92 while ULSD/cracks remain elevated.
forwardMap.invalidation: Renewed route disruption/geopolitical escalation or product cracks collapse with crude.

forwardMap.why: Lower nominal yields are supportive, but firm DXY/restrictive Fed are offsets.
forwardMap.confirmation: DXY and real yields fall together, miners outperform bullion.
forwardMap.invalidation: DXY/real yields rise and gold/miners lose support.
